messages.content_text: Just gonna do a little reflection here cuz I need somewhere to write and I don’t mind anyone reading this. I know I can do this. I just got an account, blew it, and now I’m sitting here just wondering what the actual fuck am I doing. The same shit has actually happened over and over. I take a good ass set up that ends up being an L, revenge trade, end up in more DD or a blown account then buy a new one and wait. Like i genuinely need to improve or else it’s gonna be the same thing over and over again. I’m trying to find the root of my problems. Is it bc my Ls are too big ? Am I trying to rush my evals? Am I greedy bc I’m used to using at least 1 mini? Genuinely need to figure this shit out man. Need to stop taking every set up I see. BUT EACH SET UP LOOKS GOOD? Like I understand narrative and I go with the narrative but man shit just hasn’t been working. Is it just that I need to be better at taking Ls? I think I jus gotta take 1 trade a day not 2. Cuz if I end up in an even worse position I tilt badddd. It’s so bad that every losing day ends with a blown account  or half of my progress gone. I need to be better. Any words of advice @boy I’d greatly appreciate it. Gonna be coming up to a year of trading in March and have only gotten one payout. Idk if I should be proud of myself for that or disappointed I haven’t been doing better

messages.content_text:
2nd Trade
We made a 5m RB inside of a 15m FVG
CE of wicked lined up with golden area of the fib 
also had 18:00 KO right around there.
I entered off this 15s RB ET

I managed tis trade very poorly.
I moved my stop to B/E as soon as we hit the first 1m FVG
I was scared because ES had just take ATH and was dumping and we seemed very uncorrelated.
But hindsight I noticed we put in this INT SMT which should be even more confidence for my position.
I got ticked B/E before it shot past my TP.
I let emotions win on this one because ive had a few losses in a row.
But in reality, if im comfortable putting the risk on originally, then I should not be going to B/E to quickly.
That just means my idea is working out, so I should continue to give it time to breathe.

I only get 2 trades a day and I cant be wasting good opportunities by poorly managing positions. 

Also I need to take better care of watching for SMTs.
Be more focused during the session.
Be in the zone and ignore your phone during that time. (edited)

jan 7 Notes:


Today I took a breakeven trade that stopped me out and then went to my tp and it was just because I lacked confidence and adjusted to breakeven too quickly.
,
Going into the day I was bullish because es was close to all time highs and nq had a bunch of highs to sweep too. Market opened and rallied upwards with a bit of choppy price action. 10:00 opened at the top of the morning move up and retraced into a 15m fvg. Price rejected out of it and traded up and I traded the retracement of the retracement because the 18:00 aligned with a 1min cisd and the ote. The reason I was skeptical is because The expansion out of the 15m wasn’t really sufficient so trading a retracement off of that move doesn’t seem logical. (Screenshot 1 & 2)
,
I’m not upset with this trade because my logic makes sense, it would have been more logical to not take the trade at all, but in the heat of the moment it looked good. What’s good is that I handled risk accordingly and made good of a not so good situation.
,
